items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: With Kit Clayton's band. ... I was playing with George Gaynor and Clayton at the Hummin' Boyd Cabaret.

ctx.x: Same place I guess I've heard of before. Several people told us they went there.
So I went through with him, so I went for myself. And some fellas came and hired me to play at the Hummin' Boyd Cabaret. With Kit Clayton's band.
Oh yeah, George Gaynor was about here. He used to go there, that's the first place he ever had.
